hypothesis: Removing the duplicate stage-C worker spawn and retaining one fast worker plus one heavy worker per stage will allow the pinned staged n=7 search to initialize and complete candidate scoring within the local WSL memory budget.
rationale: Pipeline-003 exhausted the WSL instance with six fast and three heavy workers. Pipeline-004 correctly reduced fast and nested CPU concurrency but still failed while initializing the upstream controller's two stage-C and one stage-D processes. This experiment changes only the aggregate worker count at source-load time: one stage-C worker and one stage-D worker remain, with one nested process each. The search families, seed, startup edge proxy, exact candidate scoring, metric, and pinned evaluator remain fixed.
expected_information_gain: Tests whether the upstream search can produce completed exact stage-A/B/C/D observations once aggregate worker initialization fits the available runtime.
method: Run the pinned examples/search_n7_async_pipeline/search_n7_async_pipeline.py through research_tools/run_kserver_n7_single_heavy.py. The wrapper asserts and removes exactly the pinned duplicate call spawn_heavy_worker('stage_c','stage_c_1',...), then executes the unchanged source in memory and narrows existing constants to FAST_WORKERS_TOTAL=1, FAST_STAGE_A_WORKERS=1, FAST_STAGE_B_WORKERS=1, STAGE_C_MAX_CPUS=1, STAGE_D_MIN_CPUS=1, and one nested process per heavy worker. Use fork multiprocessing, timeout 1800 seconds, n-cpus 2, families seed_dense,mutate_ck4,mutate_proxy,mutate_timed,mutate_full, startup seeds disabled, and tag reproduce_n7_codex_single_heavy. Preserve checkpoint/events/final output and run the exact frozen taxi evaluator on any finalist.
metric: best full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k from exact candidate scoring/evaluator
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A candidate below 3 on the exact pinned primary evaluator is finite benchmark progress toward the k-server objective, not a proof of the full conjecture; any apparent improvement requires clean reproduction, broader frozen metrics, and adversarial verification.

configuration.startup_baseline_scan: zero-valued edge-order proxy; complete pinned edge order retained

compute_budget.cpu: one fast worker; one stage-C worker; one stage-D worker; one nested potential process per heavy worker

kill_condition: Stop at the documented 1800-second search timeout, at the first candidate that passes the exact frozen evaluator and is preserved for verification, or at a precise runtime/contract failure. Do not modify the pinned evaluator or metric.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if exact evaluator returns violations_k < 3; reproduction at 3 is baseline evidence

previous_best_comparison.previous_pipeline_result: pipeline-004 failed during worker initialization before completed stage-A scoring
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: search-stage result is informative only through exact candidate scoring

interpretation: Pre-registered single-heavy-worker rerun; no candidate claim is made before execution.
recommended_next_action: If useful stage results or a candidate below 3 appear, freeze and independently verify them; otherwise preserve the failure mode and pause k-server work pending more capable compute or the missing reported candidate.
repetition_justification: This is a final runtime-capacity test after two distinct initialization failures. It removes only one duplicate upstream worker process and lowers concurrency; the search families, seed, objective, metric, adapter scoring, pinned evaluator, and mathematical target remain fixed.
